verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ bhagavā kosambiyaṁ viharati ghositārāme.
verses.english: At one time the Buddha was staying near Kosambī, in Ghosita’s Monastery.

verses.pali: Atha kho āyasmā ānando yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho āyasmā ānando bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then Venerable Ānanda went up to the Buddha, bowed, sat down to one side, and said to him:

verses.pali: “Ko nu kho, bhante, hetu ko paccayo, yena mātugāmo neva sabhāyaṁ nisīdati, na kammantaṁ payojeti, na kambojaṁ gacchatī”ti?
verses.english: “Sir, what is the cause, what is the reason why ladies don’t attend council meetings, work for a living, or travel to Persia?”

verses.pali: ayaṁ kho, ānanda, hetu ayaṁ paccayo, yena mātugāmo neva sabhāyaṁ nisīdati, na kammantaṁ payojeti, na kambojaṁ gacchatī”ti.
verses.english: This is the cause, this is the reason why ladies don’t attend council meetings, work for a living, or travel to Persia.”
